explanation: This function is vulnerable to OS command injection (CWE-78) because path is concatenated directly into os.popen("file " + path), which invokes a system shell. Crafted input containing shell metacharacters could execute arbitrary OS commands on the host. The repair replaces os.popen() with subprocess.check_output(["file", "--", path], text=True) using shell=False and '--', preventing both shell injection and option injection (the residual scanner flag reflects a generic subprocess rule).
